products.name: SambaNova
products.note: Enterprise AI hardware+software; DataScale platform; on-prem deployment; sovereign AI

profile_text.body:
SambaNova Systems is an AI infrastructure company that describes itself as delivering a complete platform for AI inference, fine-tuning, and agentic AI workloads, designed to integrate into existing data center environments. The company's hardware centers on its Reconfigurable Dataflow Units, or RDUs, which it positions as purpose-built for the performance demands of large frontier models. JPMorganChase is cited on the company's site as a customer that has selected SambaNova RDUs for on-premises AI inference.

The company's platform includes several named components: DataScale, a hardware and software system for on-premises deployment; SambaCloud, a cloud-based inference service that the company says was the first platform to support all three variants of Meta's Llama 3.1 at 8B, 70B, and 405B parameters; SambaStack, which manages switching between multiple frontier-scale models to support agentic workflows on a single node; and SambaOrchestrator, a tool for managing and scaling model deployments across data centers. The company also describes a sovereign AI offering, connecting customers to a network of national data center partners powered by its platform. The site notes that OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b model runs on SambaNova RDUs at over 600 tokens per second.

The held facts record a valuation of $11 billion, with a funding round led by General Atlantic and joined by Seligman Ventures and T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc. The company's tracked product is listed under the Chat and General LLMs category, reflecting its positioning across both enterprise hardware and model-serving software.
